additional_info.subject: RE: ID0414502-DC/Si-D/DK[qntu3k] - DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100 CRM:00315002467
additional_info.body:
Went to the site and did the measurements.
PT1000 sensors showed zero/unlimited ohm.
No connection through the resistor.
I replaced the cable and the charger is fully working again.
